title: Circuit Digitization: hand-drawn schematics to structural circuit netlists with an endpoint-graph wire join and a human-verified connectivity benchmark
description: Software for recovering structural circuit netlists from scanned hand-drawn schematics using component detection, an occlusion-first wire extractor, and an endpoint-graph join with degree-budget completion. The reported component-pair benchmark evaluates 31 human-verified CGHD-1152 images with annotated component boxes; it does not establish autonomous image-to-netlist accuracy, pin identity, component values, or simulation equivalence. Also includes synthetic-circuit generation, join and baseline benchmarks, and a VLM connectivity harness. Our source code and own annotations (net connectivity, wire polylines) are released under MIT; material derived from CGHD-1152 (overlay images under ground_truth/net_gt_ui_overlays/ and component annotations under ground_truth/component_labels/) remains under CC BY 4.0; reference nets derived from CGHD v12 annotations (ground_truth/cghd_ref/, ground_truth/cghd_ref_audit/) are released under CC BY-SA 4.0. See LICENSE.txt and ground_truth/LICENSE.
